Robinson, Rice & Kadavy (1998) developed two empirical equations for median riprap size D<sub>50</sub> based on chute slope and unit discharge. Equation 1 applies for mild slopes (S<sub>0</sub> < 0.10); Equation 2 applies for steep slopes (0.10 ≤ S<sub>0</sub> ≤ 0.40). Both equations require q<sub>t</sub> in m²/s and return D<sub>50</sub> in mm. The validated range is 0.02 ≤ S<sub>0</sub> ≤ 0.40.
Robinson, K.M., Rice, C.E., and Kadavy, K.C. (1998). “Design of rock chutes.” Transactions of the ASAE, 41(3), 621–626. USDA ARS also publishes an Excel spreadsheet based on the same method.
